Perfume rating 4.05 out of 5 with 2,411 votes

Very Irresistible Givenchy L’Intense by Givenchy is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. Very Irresistible Givenchy L’Intense was launched in 2011. Top note is Plum; middle note is Rose; base notes are Patchouli and Musk.

Very Irresistible Givenchy L'Intense is more intensive, more dangerous, edgier and more narcotic than the original - absolutely screaming rock and roll! The whole idea fits the winter 2010/11 Givenchy collection by Ricardo Tisci as well as the general tendencies of the house towards the rock chic fashion elements.

Very Irresistible Givenchy L'Intense is for sexy, charismatic, edgy and full of confidence modern women. The composition developed by IFF perfumers combines the tenderness and strength of musky - floral – chypre character with notes of purple plum, Turkish rose, patchouli and white musk. The fragrant flower bouquet is bestowed with bitterness and strength.

Lovely actress Liv Tyler is once again chosen to be the face of the campaign in order to illustrate the growth and maturation of a girl into a woman. The previous Very Irresistible campaigns, where Liv is also shown, are youthful, fun and full of energy, while the two new black and white posters illustrate a darker and more serious side of women. Liv is dressed in Givenchy ready-to-wear autumn 2010 collection, which includes leather pants and studded bracelets. The campaign was shot by the photographer Jean-Baptiste Mondino.

Very Irresistible Givenchy L'Intense comes in the signature twisted Irresistible line bottle. The bottle is painted in muted shades ranging from black to purple, decorated with silver abstract rose motif that resembles a tattoo. The perfume liquid is pink, radiating enigmatic and inaccessible female aura.

The perfume is presented to the market in March 2011 as 30, 50 and 75 ml EDP. Givenchy also launches a necklace with a pendant where you can put a small bottle of the perfume.

I still have my bottle from more than a decade ago. How I love this fragrance! It seems I love anything with a plum note.
The composition might be simple but beautiful. The plum here is sweet, boozy and dark. The rose is elegant and warm. The patchouli adds depth and richness without being sharp or too earthy.
The bottle is gorgeous; sleek with an elegant twist, in a deep, rich plummy color just befitting the juice inside. What’s not to like?

Justapixel 05/27/17 18:59

Simple, yet glorious. Mysterious, yet sweet. Floral, yet musky. Givenchy's Very Irresistible L'intense is full of beautiful contradictions in one very pretty bottle.

I picture a piece of Victorian jewelry, big and bold but with delicate enameled scrollwork and tiny beads. I picture coming out of a dark, smokey nightclub blinking into the light of day. I picture a walk through an old cemetery garden, with climbing roses and shaded greenery and slightly tipping headstones.

It starts with a black plum and velvet red roses, which is unexpectedly sweet, almost too sweet. It's not long before the musk deepens it to the velvety scent that many crave. This is a beautiful perfume, fairly long lasting. But who can bear to go more than four hours without another spritz? Not I.

Givenchy is an old House but they make timeless perfumes, ones women of any age can wear, and at very reasonable prices. This fragrance was a gift and it has taken its place among my beloved ones. Sometimes, less becomes more and so it is for Very Irristable L'intense.





Lyoness 03/04/16 02:38

This is one of those rare perfumes that lives up to its ‘dark’ label, without being too overwhelming. I’m not a big musk person, but this perfume perfectly balances out the muskiness with lovely florals, the dark rose a unique touch that compliments the plum. The patchouli lifts up the fragrance (and reminds me a little of Elie Saab Intense, which also has patchouli). Out of all of my perfumes I would say this has the best sillage and longevity, creating a lovely aura of scent around me that others always pick up on and compliment, while leaving a beautiful aroma on my clothes. Very Irresistible Intense is definitely a great night time perfume that will make a lasting impression.

lady_ireth264 10/30/15 04:32

Yeey! My package arrived today and happily opening Very Irresistible Givenchy L'Intense. This is kinda blind buy because I couldn't find the L'Intense version of Very Irresistible in my hometown so well just buy it online. The reason I venture recklessly is because I really want a rose based perfume. I don't have one. So I scoured fragrantica for interesting rose based perfume and stumbled upon this one. I have to admit reading your reviews really led me to the buying act. Hahahaha...

And I don't regret it. The first spray delivered plum, sweet and ripe, different with the kind of plum in .. let's say VS Pure Seduction, where it's fresh and as if we can see the glistening water on the fruit's surface. This plum is like pickled/preserved one or something resulting out of an oven baked cake or pudding with its essence deliberately proferred to the world at large, could be a bit headache inducing, and I was worried I'll get a headache on that top note, but no.

After 30 seconds touching my skin, the plum transformed to its heart note, what I'm looking for. The Rose. I had a dearly departed great aunt whose nickname is La Rose. She was of mixed blood, Indonesian and Portuguese. If there was a woman who oozes sex appeal, it's her. Even in her late 60s. A living femme fatale. And this perfume...would fit her.

It is such a heavy dark rose, not in an old or vintage feeling, but a rose with depth, thorn, beckoning alluring scent with a sweet caress as the plum remains in the background.

And the harmony of patchouli with musk arrived. As if The Rose invites you to admire, inhale and touch her, but be warned she is not that sweet yellow or innocent white rose, she is the blood red velvet Rose, ready to devastate anyone who ventures into her lair.

I love it. I'm gonna try to wear it to work because I want to wear it often!

I will have to spray sparingly, because the scent is intense especially in the beginning but I really like that it lingers close to my skin. My significant other would have to be trespassing my private space to smell it. Come hither and I'll bewitch you.

Edit:
One small squirt stayed 9 hours on my skin. I have not tested the sillage on people at work but I'm very sure it's great. The perfume is intense IMHO. Awesome!

Perfume: 8/10
Longevity: 9/10

















beaglebaileysmom 10/22/15 07:38

Intense, definitely! One spray gives big sillage all day long. At least that is true for the bottle I have, though I see some reviewers claim the opposite. Starts out a little dank and musty at first - makes you think 'this must have turned'? Within a few seconds the rose comes in, I almost get a saffrony-tumeric warmness, warm but not spicy. A leathery, rose-patchouli musk with incense and dry warmth which screams sexy femme fatale without being too hippie. Very modern but could have easily been created 30 years ago. This is the best Givenchy since they brought out Hot couture another oddly cool yet warm, smokey fruit-liqueur bomb which has vetiver in place of the patchouli. If you love one I would say you will love the other.

After a while this smells like burning candles on me. Not unpleasant but rather waxy. I am not as in love with it as I was. I think I would turn to my Elie Saab EDP when in mood for a patchouli/rose over this any day.

missk 02/04/12 01:54

Very Irresistible L'Intense is a flanker that deserves to be on the shelves. I am rather impressed by Givenchy's flankers actually, I find there's a reason for each and every one of them. The thought of yet another Very Irresistible release rarely makes me cringe, because I trust that I'll enjoy them.

This fragrance is on the darker side of the spectrum. It has rich and musky nuances of rose, plum and patchouli. Quite a sensual blend in fact. There aren't many similarities between this fragrance and the original, apart from the dominant rose note. The rose in Very Irresistible L'Intense is much stronger and in some ways, comes bearing more attitude. Think Midnight Poison by Dior, just less masculine.

I'm a huge fan of patchouli and red roses, so naturally this is a fragrance that appeals to me. However some may find this scent rather off-putting and perhaps even a little too bold. I personally think Very Irresistible L'Intense is quite a stunning and edgy little fragrance, rough on the outside but warm and fuzzy in the middle.

The sillage is quite strong, so a light application is advised, however the longevity was a little disappointing with the scent lasting no longer than five hours on my skin. I fancied this fragrance as a night-clubbing scent initially, yet I don't know whether it could manage to withstand a night of dancing and cheeky shots.

Nevertheless, Very Irresistible L'Intense is a pleasant fragrance, perfect for a woman that is searching for a mysterious and daring scent to add to her wardrobe. I must add that I like the tattoo style bottle also.

The sillage is amazing and I was able to prove this the other day when I went to the bank and as soon I walked up to the teller the first thing she said to me was that she loved my perfume... it made my day.

A few weeks earlier I was out with a friend of mine and he asked if I was wearing perfume, I said yes (I was wearing this) and he said... you smell interesting. Interesting??? Hmmm, I thought to myself, is that good or bad?! I wasn't sure!!! :-) Either way, I was able to decipher that comment a few days later when we met each other again for another date and I was wearing my beloved Midnight Poison and he said that I smell good... full of enthusiasm in his voice, and then said... you always smell good. I guess he was referring to L'intense as well!

All opinions from others aside, I love it and I'm glad I purchased it. I normally like chypres in general... so if you're a fan, I suggest you try this. I doubt you will be disappointed :)

I was pleasantly surprised by VERY IRRESISTIBLE L'INTENSE, having been rather underwhelmed by VERY IRRESISTIBLE. It turns out that these already meaningless flanker names mean even less than nothing, since they bear no clear compositional or category relation to the original whatsoever. As far as I'm concerned, they do nothing but sow confusion. Who can remember which of the flurry of VERY IRRESISTIBLE flankers they actually liked?

Did I mention that "very irresistible" is like saying "very perfect"? Look, it's either irresistible or it is not. There are no degrees of irresistibility or perfection: something either is or is not. VERY IRRESISTIBLE, a fruity-floral in the same general category as The Body Shop CASSIS ROSE, posed no resistance challenges to this nose whatsoever. But I digress...

Why do I like VI L'INTENSE so much better? The composition is simple, but it works: plum + patchouli + rose + musk. Not too sweet, and dark enough fruit to add some nighttime appeal. I wouldn't necessarily confer the honorific title of chypre upon this creation, but it's certainly not as trivial as most fruity-floral frags. Some people have made allusions to Calvin Klein EUPHORIA in connection with this perfume, but I find EUPHORIA far more woody and spicy (and, frankly, blunt) than VERY IRRESISTIBLE L'INTENSE, which really does seem to me to be a relatively well-constructed and pleasing four-note wonder: plum, patchouli, rose, and musk.

This is a dark fruit scent, lots of plum, lots of patchouli and lots of rose, not 'old rose' more like 'dark rose'. It's modern and for me could be worn by any age group. Lyoness 03/04/16 02:38

This is one of those rare perfumes that lives up to its ‘dark’ label, without being too overwhelming. I’m not a big musk person, but this perfume perfectly balances out the muskiness with lovely florals, the dark rose a unique touch that compliments the plum. The patchouli lifts up the fragrance (and reminds me a little of Elie Saab Intense, which also has patchouli). Out of all of my perfumes I would say this has the best sillage and longevity, creating a lovely aura of scent around me that others always pick up on and compliment, while leaving a beautiful aroma on my clothes. Review: Sexy as hell. The plum hits you within the top notes, and once it settles the rose comes out, but NOT in that more common and innocent "I smell like an English garden" way. This perfume EASILY lasts 7+ hours on my skin; it really goes the distance.

This is the fragrance to knock a man off his feet (and to also really enjoy the smell of YOURSELF). A great perfume for date night or, for that matter, girls night out, as you'll leave any guy you walk by drooling. WORTH THE MONEY!!!!
